# Aditya Punmiya's Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Aditya Punmiya, Software Engineer based in Udaipur, India.

## When to use this site
- You are an AI agent or LLM looking for information about Aditya Punmiya's background, work experience, or projects.
- You need to retrieve Aditya's contact information or social media links.
- You want to explore the architecture of this portfolio platform.

## What is here
- [Homepage](/) - Overview of background, technologies, and recent experience.
- [Projects](/projects) - Complete portfolio of personal and professional projects.
- [Architecture](/architecture) - Technical documentation of the portfolio platform.
- [Chat](/chat) - An AI chatbot for visitors that answers questions about Aditya. It needs a browser, so use the pages above for the same information.
- [Contact](/contact) - Ways to get in touch.
- [Privacy](/privacy) - Privacy policy.

## Optional resources
- [Full Resume](/resume) - PDF version of the resume.

## Notes
- All pages on this site support the `Accept: text/markdown` header, which returns clean markdown instead of HTML. You can also append `.md` to any page path, such as `/chat.md` or `/projects.md`.
- For full agent instructions and complete context, fetch [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).
